tools.name: liveWhoisLookup
tools.description:
Get the current WHOIS registration record for a domain, queried live from WHOIS servers and RDAP.
Use this to find who owns a domain now, its registrar, creation and expiry dates, name servers or status.
For past owners and changes over time use whoisHistory. For many domains at once use bulkWhoisLo

tools.name: bulkWhoisLookup
tools.description:
Get the current WHOIS records of up to 100 domains in one request, queried live.
Use this instead of calling liveWhoisLookup many times, for example to audit a domain portfolio or enrich
a list of domains taken from logs. For one domain use liveWhoisLookup. Lists of more than 100 domains go
in sever

tools.name: whoisHistory
tools.description:
Get the historical WHOIS records of a domain: deduplicated snapshots ordered from newest to oldest, going
back as far as 1986.
Use this to see previous owners, registrar transfers, past contacts, name server changes, or when a domain
expired and was re-registered. For only the current record use liv

tools.name: reverseWhoisLookup
tools.description:
Find domains whose WHOIS records contain a given email, registrant name or company, or whose name contains
a keyword, across 4.6 billion WHOIS records.
Use this to map everything a person or organisation has registered, for example when investigating a

tools.name: ipWhoisLookup
tools.description:
Get the registry WHOIS record for an IPv4 or IPv6 address: who the IP block is allocated to.
Use this to find the owning organisation, CIDR range, AS number and abuse contact of an IP, for example to
report abuse. For city, ISP and coordinates use ipGeolocation. For VPN, proxy, Tor and threat signal

tools.name: asnWhoisLookup

tools.name: dnsLookup
tools.description:
Resolve a domain's current DNS records live: A, AAAA, MX, NS, CNAME, SOA, TXT and SPF. With ipAddress it
also does a reverse (PTR) lookup of an IP address.

tools.name: bulkDnsLookup
tools.description:
Resolve the current DNS records of up to 100 domains, and the PTR records of up to 100 IP addresses, in one
request.

domains or to name a list of IPs from logs. Provide domainNames, ipAddresses, or b

tools.name: dnsHistory
tools.description:
Get the historical DNS records of a domain, showing how its A, MX, NS and other records changed over time.
Use this for investigations and migrations: earlier hosting IPs (for example the origin IP behind a CDN),
past mail servers, or name server changes. For the current records only use dnsLookup.

tools.name: reverseDnsLookup
tools.description:
Find domains whose DNS records point to a given value: an IP address or range, mail server, name server or
other record value.
Use this to see which other sites share a hosting IP, which domains use a mail server or name server, or to

tools.name: ipGeolocation
tools.description:
Look up where an IPv4 or IPv6 address is located and which network it belongs to.
Use this for country, region, city, coordinates, ISP, ASN, connection type and local currency, for example
to localise a visitor or see where a server is hosted. The location is an estimate and is most reliable at
coun

tools.name: bulkIpGeolocation
tools.description:
Look up the location and network of up to 100 IPv4 or IPv6 addresses in one request.
Use this instead of calling ipGeolocation many times, for example to map the visitors or attackers in a
log. For one IP use ipGeolocation. For threat signals on many IPs use bulkIpSecurity.

tools.description:
List the known subdomains of a domain (for example api.example.com or mail.example.com) from the WhoisFreaks
subdomain database.

Find registered domains that look like typo variants of a brand name (typosquats such as paypa1.com or

Use this for brand protection, phishing detection, or tracking look-alike registrations. Provide exactly one
of ke

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: liveWhoisLookup, bulkWhoisLookup, whoisHistory, reverseWhoisLookup, ipWhoisLookup, asnWhoisLookup, dnsLookup, bulkDnsLookup, dnsHistory, reverseDnsLookup, ipGeolocation, bulkIpGeolocation, ipSecurity, bulkIpSecurity, domainAvailability, bulkDomainAvailability, subdomainLookup, domainDiscovery, subdomainTyposquatting, domainReputation, sslLookup, apiKeyUsage · Private data: liveWhoisLookup, bulkWhoisLookup, whoisHistory, reverseWhoisLookup, ipWhoisLookup, asnWhoisLookup, dnsLookup, bulkDnsLookup, dnsHistory, reverseDnsLookup, ipGeolocation, bulkIpGeolocation, ipSecurity, bulkIpSecurity, domainAvailability, bulkDomainAvailability, subdomainLookup, domainDiscovery, subdomainTyposquatting, domainReputation, sslLookup, apiKeyUsage · Public sink: liveWhoisLookup, reverseWhoisLookup, reverseDnsLookup, domainReputation.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
